fields.description: Issue includes an investigative front-page account alleging improper fees and bond-discounting practices connected with a Home Owners' Loan Corporation refinancing arranged through the Federal Savings & Loan Association and its president Harry Lipton. Regular columns ("Wen's Notebook," "Rambles and Rumbles") cover local politics and civic affairs, including discussion of tax-deed litigation involving W. H. Garrison and municipal election coverage in Hialeah. Miami Beach police commentary addresses rising traffic accident rates and calls for driver licensing; a full-page safety campaign urges traffic-law enforcement and accident prevention. The issue also features entertainment and nightlife items, wrestling promotions, and the newspaper's "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest coverage (Grant's/Kress Store).
